name: ProductCatalogUpdater
description: Keeps the Aetherion product catalog (overview, architecture, one record per feature) up to date from merged PRs, their Jira issues and docs changes. Every change is backed by quoted evidence; rewrites wait for human review.

triggers.name: repos
triggers.description: GitHub repos to read merged PRs from, comma-separated (org/repo). Leave empty to check docs only.

triggers.name: lookback_days
triggers.description: First run only: how far back to read merged PRs. Later runs continue from where the last one stopped.

triggers.name: mode
triggers.description: Shadow (propose and report only):shadow,Live (write to the catalog):live

triggers.name: include_docs
triggers.friendly_name: Check the docs site for changes

triggers.name: reviewers
triggers.description: Who to ask about changes that need review, e.g. slack:owner@company.com, teams:lead@company.com. Plain emails go to Slack.

triggers.name: review_hours
triggers.description: How long to wait for a review before leaving the changes pending for the next run (default 24).

activities.name: route_event_tool
activities.description: Reads a change event and the catalog index, and names the features and components it touches.

activities.name: extract_claims_tool
activities.description: Extracts atomic product facts from PR, Jira and docs text, each with a verbatim quote.

activities.name: verify_claims_tool
activities.description: Checks each claim strictly against its quote and rejects anything the quote doesn't state.

activities.name: compose_ops_tool
activities.description: Turns verified claims into catalog update lines and field edits.

activities.name: check_ops_tool
activities.description: Checks that each drafted change says nothing beyond its claims, narrowing it if needed.
